items.title: AMD Jumps 3.5% as Its $2 Trillion-Plus AI Promise Raises the Stakes
items.summary: The opportunity dwarfs AMD's current business, leaving execution and supply--not market size--as the decisive tests.

items.title: What Qualcomm Has Stopped Leading With
items.summary: Qualcomm (QCOM) has spent years telling shareholders it is becoming more than a smartphone chip company. What changed is where the new growth is expected to come from. Two years ago the big non-handset targets were automotive and IoT. Today, the newest leg of the story runs through the data center, and management has already put a number on it.

items.title: Did You Already Pay For NVIDIA's Bigger Guide?
items.summary: NVIDIA (NVDA) trades at $225.73, about 4% below its 52-week high after a 35% total return over the past twelve months. Management has just told the market to expect a much larger revenue quarter, and the easy read is that a step that size cannot already be in the price. But the stock's reaction suggests investors have already absorbed much of the news. The question is how much of the revenue step translates into value for shareholders.

items.title: Defiance Politely Asks the SEC to Let It Sell An ETF 8-Ball
items.summary: Sixteen new Defiance ETFs would reset 2x leverage six times a session, which is more leverage than the SEC’s current 3x line in the sand

items.title: AMD Rises 8% in a Month: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: AMD returns 7.7% in a month as AI and Data Center growth strengthens, but premium valuation, competition and supply constraints support a hold.

items.title: Should You Buy Intel Stock Because The Comeback Is Working?
items.summary: Intel (INTC) has been repriced as a comeback over the past year, and the products are cooperating. Revenue reached $16.1 billion in the second quarter of 2026, up 25% from a year earlier, while trailing-twelve-month revenue was up 7.5% to $57.0 billion. The server line is supply-constrained. The harder question is what your money buys at this price.

items.title: Could Marvell Be the Next AI Stock to Deliver 100% Upside?
items.summary: Marvell has already handed investors a 242% gain over the past year, yet Wall Street analysts are piling on fresh buy ratings ahead of an October catalyst that could define the next leg of the trade.

items.title: AMD, IBD Stock Of The Day, Runs Past Early Buy Point As Chipmaker Returns To Favor
items.summary: AMD is the IBD Stock Of The Day after the chipmaker's shares surged above a key technical level.
